GU: unconditional historical trajectories (no market information); reference only
G0_b3: market-informed baseline: historical trajectories kernel-weighted on closing spread and total (triangular, half-widths 6 and 9 points, season half-life 6, 10% wide-kernel floor); one weighted trajectory set per game gives coherent joint probabilities
G1_b3: G0 + ridge-learned exponential tilt of the trajectory weights from team tendency features (pace, neutral pass rate, efficiency, sacks); residual targets from leave-one-game-out G0 means; strong ridge (lambda by leave-one-season-out)
G2_b3: G0 + tilt from coaching tenure proxies and score-dependent play calling (pass rate trailing / leading by 7+)
G3_b3: G0 + tilt from matchup interactions (pass, rush, pace, explosive)
G4: simplified drive-level state-transition Markov chain (time bucket x margin bin x spread bin x total tercile cells, 40-drive backoff), 2000 Monte Carlo paths per game, started from pregame spread and total only
G5: hybrid: mixture of G0 and the one advancing component (G1); weight fitted on the previous three seasons' out-of-sample forecasts
T1/T2/T3: team-level offensive behaviour: market-conditioned kernel mean + ridge residual from tendency / situational+coaching / interaction features
